description.subtitle: First gear T-shirt Red Bull Salzburg Puma 2026 2027 - white
description.tagline: Defiende los colores del Red Bull Salzburgo
description.intro: The Puma T-shirt from the first outfit of the Red Bull Salzburg 2026 2027 combines the club tradition with a modern design designed to offer maximum comfort both inside and outside the pitch. Its lightweight fabric with dryCELL technology keeps the skin dry so you can enjoy each game with total comfort.
key_benefits: Official design: Replica of the first team of Red Bull Salzburg for the 2026/27 season.
Increased breathability: DryCELL technology helps to evacuate sweat during effort.
Durable comfort: Light jacquard fabric that offers a pleasant touch throughout the day.
Libertad de movimiento: Corte deportivo pensado para entrenar, jugar o vestir a diario.
Sustainable Commitment: Made of recycled polyester to reduce environmental impact.
